description: Use this when the user weighs two to five campaigns against each other: side by side Alpha Score, the four factor verdicts, pay per clip at 10K, 50K and 100K views, budget left and the run-out forecast, ranked in the order to clip them, with a one line recommendation drawn from the verdicts. Read only.

campaigns.description: 2 to 5 campaigns, each as brand/series, a page URL or a campaignId.

items.description: The campaign as brand/series (for example lovable/clipping), its clippingalpha.com page URL, or its numeric campaignId from another tool.

name: compare_campaigns
title: Compare campaigns
